title: Docker Compose Complete Cheat Sheet
description: Comprehensive quick reference for Docker Compose: services, builds, networks, volumes, environment, health checks, multi-service apps, and deployment patterns.

data.title: Basic Service — Simple Web Service
data.code:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx:latest
    ports:
      - "80:80"
    environment:
      - NGINX_HOST=localhost
    volumes:
      - ./html:/usr/share/nginx/html

data.title: Basic Service — Image vs Build
data.code:
services:
  web:
    # Use a pre-built image from Docker Hub
    image: nginx:1.25

  api:
    # Or build from a Dockerfile in the project
    build: .
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"

data.title: Ports & Networking — Ports Mapping
data.code:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    ports:
      # HOST:CONTAINER
      - "8080:80"
      # Random host port
      - "3000"
      # Specific IP binding
      - "127.0.0.1:8080:80"

data.title: Ports & Networking — expose
data.code:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    expose:
      - "80"
      - "443"
    # expose makes the port available to linked services
    # but does not publish it to the host machine.

data.title: Volumes — Named Volumes
data.code:
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:15
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data

volumes:
  postgres-data:
    # Named volume managed by Docker
    driver: local

data.title: Volumes — Bind Mounts
data.code:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    volumes:
      # Mount local directory into container
      - ./src:/usr/share/nginx/html
      # Read-only bind mount
      - ./nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro

data.title: Build Configuration — Dockerfile Path
data.code:
services:
  api:
    build:
      # Path to build context (defaults to current directory)
      context: .
      # Path to Dockerfile relative to context
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.prod
      # Optional: pass build-time variables
      args:
        NODE_ENV: production

data.title: Build Configuration — Multi-Stage Build Target
data.code:
services:
  api:
    build:
      context: .
      target: production
      # Only build up to the 'production' stage in a multi-stage Dockerfile

data.title: Environment Variables — env_file
data.code:
services:
  web:
    image: myapp
    env_file:
      - .env
      - .env.override
    # env_file loads variables from files.
    # Later files override earlier ones.

data.title: Environment Variables — Variable Substitution
Service Dependencies — depends_on
data.code:
services:
  web:
    build: .
    depends_on:
      - db
      - redis
    # In v2, depends_on controls startup order only.
    # Use healthcheck with condition for service readiness.

data.title: Service Dependencies — depends_on with Condition
data.code:
services:
  web:
    build: .
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy

  db:
    image: postgres:15
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

data.title: Health Checks — Basic Healthcheck
data.code:
services:
  api:
    image: myapp
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:3000/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s
    # States: starting, healthy, unhealthy

data.title: Restart Policies — no, always, on-failure
data.code:
services:
  worker:
    image: myapp
    restart: on-failure
    # Options:
    # - "no"       : never restart (default)
    # - "always"   : always restart
    # - "on-failure": restart only if exited with non-zero
    # - unless-stopped: restart unless manually stopped

data.title: Resource Limits — mem_limit and cpus
data.code:
services:
  api:
    image: myapp
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          cpus: '0.5'
          memory: 512M
        reservations:
          cpus: '0.25'
          memory: 256M

data.title: Logging — Log Options
data.code:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
        # Rotate logs after 10MB, keep 3 files

data.title: Networks (Top-Level) — Declaring Networks
data.code:
networks:
  frontend:
    driver: bridge
  backend:
    driver: bridge
    internal: true # no external access

services:
  web:
    networks:
      - frontend
  api:
    networks:
      - frontend
      - backend

data.title: Multi-Service App — Full Stack Example
data.code:
version: '3.8'
services:
  frontend:
    build: ./frontend
    ports: ["3000:3000"]
    depends_on: [api]
    networks: [frontend]

  api:
    build: ./api
    ports: ["4000:4000"]
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgres://user:pass@db:5432/app
    depends_on: [db, redis]
    networks: [frontend, backend]

  db:
    image: postgres:15
    volumes: [db-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data]
    networks: [backend]

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    networks: [backend]

volumes:
  db-data:

networks:
  frontend:
  backend:

data.title: Environment Files — .env File Format
data.code:
# .env file
POSTGRES_USER=admin
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=secret
POSTGRES_DB=myapp

API_PORT=4000
NODE_ENV=development

# Values may be quoted
DEBUG="app:*"

data.title: Command & Entrypoint — Overriding Command
data.code:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    # Override the default CMD from the Dockerfile
    command: nginx -g "daemon off;"
    # Or override ENTRYPOINT
    entrypoint: /bin/sh -c

data.title: Secrets — Secrets Top-Level
data.code:
secrets:
  db_password:
    file: ./secrets/db_password.txt

services:
  db:
    image: postgres
    secrets:
      - db_password
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/db_password

data.title: Configs — Configs Top-Level
data.code:
configs:
  nginx_config:
    file: ./nginx/nginx.conf

services:
  nginx:
    image: nginx
    configs:
      - source: nginx_config
        target: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf

data.title: Profiles — Activating Profiles
data.code:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    profiles: ["frontend"]

  api:
    image: myapp
    profiles: ["backend"]

  test-runner:
    image: test-runner
    profiles: ["testing"]

# Run with: docker compose --profile frontend up

data.title: Docker Compose Commands — Up and Down
data.code:
# Start services in detached mode
docker compose up -d

# Start and rebuild images
docker compose up --build -d

# Stop and remove containers, networks, volumes
docker compose down

# Stop and remove volumes too
docker compose down -v

# View running services
docker compose ps

# View logs
docker compose logs -f web

data.title: Overriding with Multiple Files
data.code:
# Run with an override file
docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.override.yml up

# compose.override.yml
services:
  web:
    build:
      args:
        NODE_ENV: development
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
      - "9229:9229" # debug port

data.title: Labels & Metadata — Service Labels
data.code:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    labels:
      com.example.description: "Web frontend"
      com.example.version: "1.0.0"
      # Labels are key-value pairs for metadata

data.title: Init & TTY — init and tty
data.code:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    init: true          # Use tini as PID 1 (handles signals properly)
    stdin_open: true    # Keep STDIN open
    tty: true           # Allocate a pseudo-TTY
    # privileged: false # Avoid unless absolutely necessary

data.title: tmpfs Mounts
data.code:
services:
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    tmpfs:
      - /data
      - /run
    # tmpfs mounts are stored in memory and not persisted to disk.
    # Useful for temporary files or caches.

data.title: Network Modes — host, bridge, none
data.code:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    network_mode: bridge # default

  # Use host networking (container shares host's network stack)
  # Caution: port conflicts possible
  api:
    image: myapp
    network_mode: host

  # No networking (isolated)
  worker:
    image: myapp
    network_mode: none

data.title: External Volumes and Networks
data.code:
volumes:
  db-data:
    external: true # Volume must already exist

networks:
  mynet:
    external: true # Network must already exist

# Create external volume: docker volume create db-data
# Create external network: docker network create mynet

data.title: Docker Compose Commands — Build and Pull
data.code:
# Build all services
docker compose build

# Build without cache
docker compose build --no-cache

# Pull latest images
docker compose pull

# Run a one-off command
 docker compose run --rm web ls -la

# Execute a command in a running container
docker compose exec db psql -U postgres

data.title: Docker Compose Commands — Stop and Start
data.code:
# Stop services (without removing)
docker compose stop

# Start stopped services
docker compose start

# Restart services
docker compose restart

# Validate compose file
docker compose config
